what: Kuskokwim airborne survey mosaic for No.92: residual magnetic intensity (nT) then digital terrain (m), each little-endian int16 row-major north up, nodata -32768, on a 500 m UTM zone 4N grid
source: Alaska DGGS Geophysical Reports 2026-1 (Ganes Creek, doi 10.14509/31746) and 2026-2 (McGrath, doi 10.14509/31804), grids_tif residual magnetic and DTM at 100 m, block-averaged to 500 m; fetched 2026-10-22 from dggs.alaska.gov/webpubs/data; open end-user license
projection: WGS 84 / UTM zone 4N (EPSG 32604); column i is easting x0 + (i+0.5)*cell, row j is northing y1 - (j+0.5)*cell
note: Aniak and Little Taylor Mountains (GPR 2026-5) publishes colour images only, so it is absent from this grid; its outline and flight lines are in ak-kuskokwim-surveys.geo.json
